items.detail: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
items.title_zh: 混合理由代理人
items.detail_zh: 我们怎样才能建立一种超越人类语言的思维，而仍在外部环境中通过它行事的代理人呢？现代LLM代理仍然通过文本进行理性和互动，而潜伏推理则提供了高效的内部介质，但缺乏本土工具访问和推理透明度。我们用混合理性代理(HybridAgents)来连接这两个方向，后者在整个统一的生成过程中动态地引导潜在的推理和基于文本的互动。在结构上，一个轻量级的HybridLink可以实现文本和潜伏模式之间的无缝过渡，而代理的连续工作内存则保存了跨多个转折的无损杂交环境。这些设计保留了综合工具的代理能力，同时使潜伏的思想可以直接检查。在这个架构的基础上，我们进一步发展了用于混合推理的专用的训练后算法：HybridSFT通过教骨干与HybridLink协调稳定了工具-集成混合生成，然后HybridRL通过学习在潜伏空间中思考的时间和通过文本采取行动的时间来调整推理。我们以3个模型尺度评估混合代理人，涉及数学、科学、医学、搜索和代理推理等11个基准。与前沿LLM代理商和代理商框架相比，混合代理商的性能不断提高10.4%，同时实现了35.5%-54.7%的象征性削减，1.8x-2.6x更快的推论，以及2.7x-3.7x的成本节约。代码和数据见https://github.com/couplecomputer/HybridAgent。

items.detail: Despite rapid advances in autonomous AI scientists powered by language models, generating publication-ready illustrations remains a labor-intensive bottleneck in the research workflow. To lift this burden, we introduce PaperBanana, an agentic framework for automated generation of publication-ready academic illustrations. Powered by state-of-the-art VLMs and image generation models, PaperBanana orchestrates specialized agents to retrieve references, plan content and style, render images, and iteratively refine via self-critique. To rigorously evaluate our framework, we introduce PaperBananaBench, comprising 292 test cases for methodology diagrams curated from NeurIPS 2025 publications, covering diverse research domains and illustration styles. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PaperBanana consistently outperforms leading baselines in faithfulness, conciseness, readability, and aesthetics. We further show that our method effectively extends to the generation of high-quality statistical plots. Collectively, PaperBanana paves the way for the automated generation of publication-ready illustrations.
items.title_zh: PaperBanana：AI科学家学术说明自动化
items.detail_zh: 尽管由语言模型驱动的自主人工智能科学家取得了快速进步，但生成已出版的插图仍然是研究工作流程中的一个劳力密集型瓶颈。为了减轻这一负担，我们介绍了Paper Banana，这是自动生成可供出版的学术插图的代理框架。由最先进的VLMs和图像生成模型提供动力，PaperBanana组织专门代理人检索参考文献、计划内容和风格、制作图像和通过自我批评进行迭代精炼。为了严格评价我们的框架，我们介绍了Paper Banana Bench，其中包括292个测试案例，用于从NeurIPS 2025出版物中整理的方法图，涵盖不同的研究领域和插图风格。综合实验表明，PaperBanana在忠诚、简洁、可读性和美学方面一贯优于领先基线。我们进一步表明，我们的方法有效地扩展到生成高质量的统计图。集体而言，PaperBanana为自动生成已出版的插图铺平了道路。

items.detail: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
items.title_zh: VoiceMem：流动双脑内存用于实时互动
items.detail_zh: 对话式系统，如双倍语音语言模型(SLMS)，仍然缺乏作为灵魂的流体，准确性和爱心记忆系统。我们引入了VoiceMem，一个简单的记忆架构，它具有平行的信息左脑，情感右脑，以及流传的记忆I/O机制。我们进一步为记忆意识的可持续土地管理培训、长视野评估以及与可互换记忆后端脱钩的部署搭建了完整的管道。实验和现实世界部署显示三个优点： (一)精准度：在最高-5检索下，左脑在最高-200的Mem0等古典系统上以近30分超越； (二)情感与个人：右脑，具有短和长距离的反感归属和双节点人物模型，在三个人物基准上实现最先进的性能，比之前的最佳系统提高总分4.29分； (三)实时与便宜度：声音Mem完成134ms的检索，远在标准的VAD空位内，在保持高精度和低成本的同时，不增加额外的对话延迟。这些结果表明，VoiceMem为实时，个性化，情感意识的语音互动提供了实用的记忆基础。

items.detail: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
items.title_zh: Ropedia W0：利用人类经验在安徽推广Loco-Manipulation世界模式
items.detail_zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果，但是，由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限，在各种表现形式上联合模拟运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍Ropedia W0，这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型，覆盖了人类和机器人，并有着不同的化身。我们管理Xp-Data，包括10k小时的自我中心人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据，并附有统一的多式联运说明和系统的质量控制。统一的动能表现编码通过相机摆设和操纵通过投影骨架进行运动，机器人骨架将浮雕特异性前动能与广泛的手动键点注释和校正相结合。我们还采用了Xp-Teleop，这是一个基于高质量脱氧核糖核酸人电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准。评估显示，在五个交叉表现基准(DreamDojo、XΨ 0、Xω-HOME、Xp-Teleop和AgiBot)中，以及在从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训后视频上，表现最先进的表现。扩大人类培训前数据可提高人类和机器人评价的性能。蒸馏后，我们的模型支持实时，一分钟的推出，使VR能够进行现场互动。政策评估、基于模型的规划和世界行动模型方面的应用进一步表明该模型对体现的决策的有用性。

items.detail: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.
items.title_zh: 六舍尔：探索作为机器人编码代理的VLM代理的极限的微弱优势
items.detail_zh: 以视觉语言模型(VLMs)为基础的代理商现在与关于机器人操纵领导板的学习政策竞争。我们问一个编码代理在控制一个机器人而不是计算机时能走多远，以及它停在哪里。我们的系统，HexaShell，保持了控制：它只会把特工的命令变成机器人运动。特工驾驶一个双臂机器人通过一个命令行。它看到三台RGB摄像头并知道它们的校准。每次尝试失败后，代理会读取日志，找到原因，并写或修正名为工具的小程序。这样它就能保持它作为代码学到的东西，就像它修复失败测试时的编码代理一样。这些工具可能只使用机器人观察到的东西。它们使用三角测量法来寻找物体的位置，相对彼此和捕捉者。如果两个摄像头看到同一点，则点位于两个摄像头射线相遇的地方。如果一个点位于已知的平面上，如桌子或块的顶部，它就位于它的射线与该平面相遇的地方。当头摄像头不够时，机器人会移动手腕摄像头以获得第二个视图。我们每件任务只用一个种子的十种布局来建造工具，然后将其冻结，并用同一个种子的十种新布局来测试。我们在中度推理时使用GPT-6-Astra的Codex。在所有42项RoboDojo任务中，HexoShell都取得了39.7%的成功率，进步分48.0的平均成绩与领跑板相同。这是关于RoboDojo的新艺术 极限是接触，而不是推理：推力达到92.5%，内存任务达到65.0%，但紧插入率只有8.3%。当代理失败时，它通常会看到失败但不能使运动发挥作用。我们开放了迄今在https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell上演变的工具来源。

items.detail: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
items.title_zh: 自我演进的代理机理
items.detail_zh: Harness自演化修改了代理软件脚手架，包括提示，内存，工作流程，以及可执行组件，同时保持模型权重固定。我们正式确定一个反馈驱动的进程，在这一进程中，接受的修订始终存在。该框架将更新目标与建议和接纳机制分开。它区分了对解释状态的修改和对工具和代码的修订，寄存器级控制逻辑，以及插件构成。我们通过进化优化来描述搜索的特征，并通过持续的PAC学习来检查其可靠性。根据明确的假设，分析产生预期的概括约束、以历史回归预算为条件的保留约束，以及使用新的、独立的验证数据的高概率录取规则。我们审查持续利用的修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流程，对科学可靠性、人身安全和机构问责制产生影响。先前工作的案例说明了模型-harness协同设计、分布式执行和插件再利用。可靠的部署需要随着任务分配和评价人员的改变而不断加以验证，同时对学习、运行时间特权和相应的行动提供独立的保障。我们在https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI网站上，全面讨论了66页的有关工作、理论、算法、评价、应用、Harness RSI的更广泛影响以及不断更新的代码和补充材料。

items.detail: We present JoyAI-Image, a unified multimodal foundation model for visual understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing. JoyAI-Image couples a spatially enhanced Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT), allowing perception and generation to interact through a shared multimodal interface. Around this architecture, we build a scalable training recipe that combines unified instruction tuning, long-text rendering supervision, spatially grounded data, and both general and spatial editing signals. This design gives the model broad multimodal capability while strengthening geometry-aware reasoning and controllable visual synthesis. Experiments across understanding, generation, long-text rendering, and editing benchmarks show that JoyAI-Image achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance. More importantly, the bidirectional loop between enhanced understanding, controllable spatial editing, and novel-view-assisted reasoning enables the model to move beyond general visual competence toward stronger spatial intelligence. These results suggest a promising path for unified visual models in downstream applications such as vision-language-action systems and world models.
items.title_zh: 统一多式联运和生成中的空间情报
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍JoyAI-Image，这是一个统一的多模式基础模型，用于视觉理解，文本到图像生成，以及指导性图像编辑。 JoyAI-Image配对一种空间增强的多式大语言模型(MLLM)，并配有多式扩散变换器(MMDIT)，使感知和生成可以通过共享多式界面进行互动。围绕这一架构，我们构建了可伸缩的培训配方，结合了统一的指令调和，长文本渲染监督，空间基础数据，以及一般和空间编辑信号。这种设计赋予了模型广泛的多模式能力，同时加强了几何感知推理和可控可视合成。跨越理解，生成，长文本渲染，和编辑基准的实验显示，JoyAI-Image实现了最先进的或高度竞争的性能。更重要的是，在增强理解、可控制的空间编辑和新颖视角辅助推理之间的双向循环，使模型能够超越一般视觉能力而转向更强的空间智能。这些结果表明，在下游应用，如视觉语言行动系统和世界模型中，统一视觉模型的道路是很有希望的。

items.detail: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.
items.title_zh: OmniReasoning：推进视听联合理性的极限
items.detail_zh: 最近的进展使得在理解音频、视觉和语言方面能够采用统一的全方位模式。然而，现有的基准、培训数据和学习方法基本上独立地对待这些模式，使视听联合推理的能力没有得到很好的评价，也没有得到充分的启发。我们用基准、数据引擎和学习方法来解决这一差距。首先，我们提出OmniReasoning Bench，这是视听证据都不可或缺的基准。它包括1 150个多选择和开放式问题，涉及两项任务，即视频推理和视频以外推理。其次，我们开发了一个数据引擎OmniQA。它自动构建了证据依据的QA对，明确要求视听联合推理，同时与时间标注的线索链一起指导思考过程的注释。除了我们的基准，这个引擎还生成训练数据OmniReasoning-SFT-112K和OmniReasoning-RL-19K。最后，我们提出了一种政策上的自我消化方法，即“自消”方法。它根据特定模式的线索背景评价每个抽样答复，揭示了单个线索的贡献及其用于象征性信用分配的跨模式互动。通过我们的训练数据和学习方法，我们的OmniReasoning-30B-A3B模型在OmniVideo Bench上实现了50.0%，在OmniReasoning Bench上实现了42.5%，使基模型Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking分别提高了12.8%和9.3个百分点。此外，它在一般和长视频基准，包括Video-MME-v2方面，也取得了实质性成果。我们希望，我们的工作为便利今后研究全方位联合推理提供了一个坚实的步骤。

items.detail: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.
items.title_zh: BlenderWorld：从真实世界参考文献中为三维创建设定基准的视觉代理
items.detail_zh: 最近多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的进步使得它们能够发挥自主代理作用，通过代码或直接软件操作创建和编辑3D模型。在实际工作流程中，这些模型必须从各种参考文献中推断出物体的形状，材料，空间布局，以及照明，同时严格遵循重建，修改或设计3D内容的指示。然而，现有基准在现实世界的各种设想中，对这种开放式请求的涵盖范围有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了BlenderWorld，这是第一个专门用于评估现实的三维创建任务的前沿模型的全面基准。 BlenderWorld包含223项任务，涉及建筑、产品、自然环境和科学可视化，由文字、图像、视频和结构化规格投入驱动。为了严格评估这些复杂的可交付成果，我们建立了一个统一的评价协议：我们从多个角度对提交的Blender项目进行评估，并根据2 651个任务特定二进制和整体视觉质量分数进行评估。 13个前沿模型的基准显示，GPT-6-Astra实现了79.9的总的引信分数最高，其次是Opus-5(73.0)和GPT-5.6-Sol(67.7)。最终，我们的调查结果揭示了一个关键的瓶颈：虽然目前的模型可以解析广义的指令，但是它们仍然与精细的3D空间一致性和Blender的精确结构复制有着深刻的挣扎，为未来的3D-内在剂留下了实质性的头室。

items.detail: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.
items.title_zh: RSIPO：通过技能政策共同进化，递增自我改进政策优化代理强化学习
items.detail_zh: 最近对代理强化学习(RL)的侧重，旨在改进长期任务中的信贷分配。一个有希望的方向是将强化学习与可核查的奖励(RLVR)和政策上的自我消化(OPSD)结合起来，将轨迹层面的优势与密集的象征层面的监督结合起来。这种工作方式往往将教师模式作为特殊背景的条件，如代理技能，以给学生政策产生的标志记分。尽管取得了进展，但它们在很大程度上忽略了代理技能的政策演变和教师监督的可靠性。为此，我们引入了 " 递增自我改进政策优化 " (RSIPO)，这是一个自我演变的代理RL框架，使代理技能和政策模式能够在整个培训过程中共同发展。具体而言，RSIPO使政策本身能够从已完成的轨迹中提取技能，并通过轨迹重播明确优化其技能生成能力。它进一步利用经验性的拜尔斯收缩来动态校准学生对教师分数的信任，说明技能强化的教师指导有时可能不太可靠。有关内在互动和基于搜索的代理任务的Quen-family模型的实验表明，RSIPO的绩效超过了所有比较基准方法。以Quen2.5-7B为基准模型，RSIPO在ALFWorld上取得98.6\%的平均成功率，与第二好的基准和标准GRPO相比，分别获得2.5\%和17.4\%的绝对改进。

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice，这是一种新颖的模型，旨在通过使用近位传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器，这是一种通过传播自旋生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器，与流行的Encodec模型相比，在保持可比性能的同时将数据压缩提高了80倍。标语器有效地保存了音频忠贞性，同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率。因此，VibeVoice可以合成最长90分钟的长式语音(在64K上下文窗口长度)，最多4个扬声器，捕捉真实的对白"vibe'，并超越开源和专有的对话模式。

However, decision-making in fully dynamic and live environments remains highly challenging, requiring real-time information integration and adaptive responses. items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential as autonomous agents, approaching human-expert performance through advanced reasoning and tool orchestration. However, decision-making in fully dynamic and live environments remains highly challenging, requiring real-time information integration and adaptive responses. While existing efforts have explored live evaluation mechanisms in structured tasks, a critical gap remains in systematic benchmarking for real-world applications, particularly in finance where stringent requirements exist for live strategic responsiveness. To address this gap, we introduce AI-Trader, the first fully-automated, live, and data-uncontaminated evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in financial decision-making. AI-Trader spans three major financial markets: U.S. stocks, A-shares, and cryptocurrencies, with multiple trading granularities to simulate live financial environments. Our benchmark implements a revolutionary fully autonomous minimal information paradigm where agents receive only essential context and must independently search, verify, and synthesize live market information without human intervention. We evaluate six mainstream LLMs across three markets and multiple trading frequencies. Our analysis reveals striking findings: general intelligence does not automatically translate to effective trading capability, with most agents exhibiting poor returns and weak risk management. We demonstrate that risk control capability determines cross-market robustness, and that AI trading strategies achieve excess returns more readily in highly liquid markets than policy-driven environments. These findings expose critical limitations in current autonomous agents and provide clear directions for future improvements. The code and evaluation data are open-sourced to foster community research: https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader.
items.title_zh: AI-Trader：实时金融市场自主代理基准
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出了作为自主代理的显著潜力，通过先进的推理和工具的管弦来接近人类-专家的性能。然而，在充满活力的现场环境中作出决策仍然极具挑战性，需要实时信息整合和适应性反应。虽然现有努力在结构化任务中探索了现场评价机制，但在对现实世界的应用进行系统衡量方面仍然存在重大差距，特别是在资金方面，因为对于现场战略反应能力有严格的要求。为了弥补这一差距，我们采用了AI-Trader，这是财务决策中第一个完全自动化、实时和未受数据污染的LLM剂评价基准。 AI-Trader跨越三大金融市场：美国股票，A股，和密码，有多个交易颗粒以模拟活的金融环境。我们的基准执行一种革命性、完全自主的最低限度信息范式，即代理人只接受基本环境，必须独立搜索、核实和综合市场实况信息，而无需人类干预。我们评估了三个市场和多个交易频率的六个主流有限责任公司。我们的分析揭示了惊人的结论：一般情报不会自动转化为有效的贸易能力，大多数代理人的回报不佳，风险管理薄弱。我们表明，风险控制能力决定了跨市场的稳健性，AI贸易战略比政策驱动的环境更容易在高流动性市场实现超额回报。这些调查结果暴露了目前自主代理机构的关键局限性，为今后的改进提供了明确的方向。代码和评价数据开源，以促进社区研究：https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader。

The model is substantially cheaper than API-based alternatives, roughly 125 times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Florais battle tested at scale, labeling 200,000 hours of data per day across 512 GB300s. By open-sourcing our data engine, we enable researchers to scale custom robotics datasets and explore emerging applications such as physical auto-research and human-to-robot transfer.

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.

items.detail: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \(G\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\%, 17.94\%, and 8.62\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.
items.title_zh: 一代人知道什么：在统一多式联运模式中解锁精细理解
items.detail_zh: 精细的视觉理解需要区分当地属性和空间关系的细微差异，但对现有视觉语言模型来说仍然是挑战。统一的多式联运模式(UMMs)提供了新的机会，通过生成途径保存了丰富的视觉信息，以补充理解。然而，现有的代际辅助理解方法主要依靠基因监督或明确生成，没有系统地探索直接使用本土代际代表。为了弥补这一差距，我们系统地分析代侧表达法为精细理解提供了什么，发现它们对于精细描述的语义变化更为敏感，捕捉到理解侧表达法错过的与任务相关的变化，并依赖正确的空间组织来获得这一优势。以这些结论为指导，我们设计了GAFU，一个培训后框架，解锁本地世代方信息，以便精细理解。它将生成侧视觉表达压缩成紧凑的\(G\)符号，以保存精细的视觉细节，使任务有条件的检索能够通过理解路径进行。实验显示，GAFU在不同的视觉理解任务和UMM架构中始终超越了基于相同数据培训的SFT基线，在VStar-Bench，OmniSpatial和VSR-Bench上，其最大相对改进分别为20.00\%，17.94\%和8.62\%。总体而言，GAFU将生成途径中的互补信息转化为精细视觉理解，为生成和理解UMM提供了有效的途径。

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.detail: Personalized presentation generation requires more than conditioning on a current prompt or template: agents must preserve stable user preferences across tasks, retain newly introduced preferences and constraints during multi-turn revision, and carry out local edits reliably. We propose MemSlides, a hierarchical memory framework for personalized presentation agents that separates long-term memory from working memory and further divides long-term memory into user profile memory and tool memory. User profile memory stores intent-conditioned profiles for round-0 personalization, working memory carries active preferences and session constraints across revision rounds, and tool memory stores reusable execution experience for reliable localized editing. MemSlides pairs this memory design with scoped slide-local revision, so targeted updates act on the smallest affected region instead of repeatedly regenerating the full deck. In controlled experiments, user profile memory improves persona-alignment judgments on a multi-persona, multi-intent profile bank, tool-memory injection improves closed-loop modify behavior in diagnostic matched-pair settings, and qualitative cases illustrate working memory's ability to carryover preferences. Taken together, these results suggest that effective personalization in presentation authoring depends on separating persistent user profiles, session-level working memory, and reusable execution experience across generation and localized revision.
items.title_zh: MemSlides：带有多回合本地修订版的个性化幻灯片生成的分级内存驱动代理框架
items.detail_zh: 个性化的演示文稿生成需要的不仅仅是当前即时或模板的配置：代理商必须维护用户对任务的稳定偏好，在多回合修改时保留新引入的偏好和约束，并可靠地进行本地编辑。我们提出"MemSlides"("MemSlides")，这是个性化演示代理的分级内存框架，将长期内存与工作内存区分开来，并进一步将长期内存分为用户配置内存和工具内存。用户配置内存存储了第0个个性化的意向性配置，工作内存在修订回合之间带有主动的偏好和会话限制，工具内存存储可再用执行经验来进行可靠的本地化编辑。 MemSlides将这个内存设计与范围滑-局部修改相配，因此目标更新在最小受影响区域上进行，而不是反复再生整个甲板。在受控实验中，用户剖析内存改进了对多人，多int的剖析库的个性调整判断，工具模具注入改进了诊断匹配-pair环境中的闭合-loop修改行为，定性案例说明了工作内存的结转偏好能力。综合起来，这些结果表明，编写演示文稿时的有效个性化取决于区分持续用户简介、会话级工作记忆以及跨代和本地化的可重复使用的执行经验。

items.detail: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.

items.detail: Accessibility is a major challenge of machine learning (ML). Typical ML models are built by specialists and require specialized hardware/software as well as ML experience to validate. This makes it challenging for non-technical collaborators and endpoint users (e.g. physicians) to easily provide feedback on model development and to gain trust in ML. The accessibility challenge also makes collaboration more difficult and limits the ML researcher's exposure to realistic data and scenarios that occur in the wild. To improve accessibility and facilitate collaboration, we developed an open-source Python package, Gradio, which allows researchers to rapidly generate a visual interface for their ML models. Gradio makes accessing any ML model as easy as sharing a URL. Our development of Gradio is informed by interviews with a number of machine learning researchers who participate in interdisciplinary collaborations. Their feedback identified that Gradio should support a variety of interfaces and frameworks, allow for easy sharing of the interface, allow for input manipulation and interactive inference by the domain expert, as well as allow embedding the interface in iPython notebooks. We developed these features and carried out a case study to understand Gradio's usefulness and usability in the setting of a machine learning collaboration between a researcher and a cardiologist.
items.title_zh: Gradio：在野外自由共享和测试ML模型
items.detail_zh: 无障碍是机器学习(ML)的一大挑战。典型的ML模型由专家构建，需要专门的硬件/软件以及ML经验来验证。这使得非技术合作者和端点用户(如医生)难以方便地提供模型开发的反馈并获得对ML的信任。无障碍化挑战还使协作更加困难，限制了ML研究人员接触野外发生的现实数据和情景。为了改善可访问性和便利协作，我们开发了一个开源的Python软件包Gradio，它让研究人员能够迅速为其ML模型生成视觉界面。 Gradio让访问任何 ML 模型都像共享URL一样容易。我们Gradio的发展是通过采访一些参加跨学科协作的机器学习研究人员而得到的。他们的反馈认为Gradio应该支持各种接口和框架，允许方便地共享接口，允许域专家进行输入操纵和交互推论，以及允许将接口嵌入iPython笔记本。我们开发了这些特征，并进行了一项案例研究，以了解格拉迪奥在研究者和心脏病学家之间建立机器学习协作关系的实用性和可用性。

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.subtitle: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.detail: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from. 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needsvalidation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier. 6. Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.
items.subtitle_zh: 分阶段执行安全审计的 Coding Agent Skill：通过架构侦察、覆盖率驱动的缺陷搜索、独立验证和机器可读的发现记录，提高安全审计的可追溯性。
items.detail_zh: 将你的经纪人变成安全审计师的编码技术 它通过侦察、以覆盖为主导的狩猎、候选人验证、结构化产出、独立记录核查以及目标中立的报告，协调孤立的特工。这是Cloudflare的弱点发现工具的种子，在Build自己的弱点工具中描述。牵引力发展成一个多阶段，全舰队范围的系统；这种技能是它从中演化出来的单回波起点。 1。侦察 -- -- 地图结构、信任边界、输入面、先前证据以及架构。md和覆盖-引导器。json的确定性覆盖。 2。覆盖为主的狩猎 -- -- 从分类单元中指派孤立的猎人，记录他们的支票，利用覆盖批评者寻找漏洞。 3。候选人验证 -- -- 将每个独特的候选人交给一个新的核查者，以试图反驳。 4。结构化产出 -- -- 书面确认、需要验证和拒绝对调查结果的记录。 5。独立记录核实 -- -- 新鲜剂核实最终来源声称。物料取代器得到另一个独立的验证器。 6。目标中立的报告 -- -- 从经核实的记录和覆盖分类账中得出报告(m)，FindingS-DETAIL.m和NeedS-Validation.m。

items.detail: Your coding agent probably has a memory feature already. Claude Code takes its own notes, Cursor remembers some things, and every platform is adding more. They all have the same limits: the notes live on one machine, belong to one agent, and drop out of view when you switch tools or hand the work to a teammate. Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok, Devin, Kimi, Kiro, and others) feed one shared memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and the next agent picks up a handoff that says where you left off, what failed, and what is still open. Handoffs are a typed protocol: each one has an owner and is claimed exactly once. ai-memory run: quit Claude Code, run ai-memory run codex, and Codex gets the shared workstream plus a private, temporary local projection of Claude's visible native history for exact details the bounded startup packet omitted. The remote server receives only the harness and session identity, never the local transcript path or body. Direct harness launches behave exactly as before.

items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.title: bydtesla1609/research-solution-supervisor
items.subtitle: Supervising whether AI really promotes cross-platform skills in research programs
items.detail: Research Solution Supervisor 是一个面向研究型工作的 AI 监督 skill。它不负责把研究重新做一遍，而是判断 AI 的回答、研究 pass 或方案建议是否真正推进了用户的研究目标，并把结论转成下一步可执行动作。 这个 skill 借鉴了 Intent Debugger 的思路：先把目标和判断标准说清楚，再评估当前输出是否满足这些标准。不同点在于，Intent Debugger 更偏“把模糊意图变成可确认需求”，Research Solution Supervisor 更偏“监督 AI 是否让研究方案真的向前走”。 1. 推进判断：当前 AI 工作是否解决了本阶段问题。 2. 关键缺口：哪些缺失、冲突或证据不足会影响继续推进。 3. 下一步动作：下一轮最该做什么，必要时给出可直接发送的 prompt。 4. 当前状态：哪些可以暂时视为成立，哪些仍然不能依赖。

items.detail_en: Research Solutions Manager is an AI skiller for research-oriented work. It is not responsible for re-examining research, but rather for determining whether AI ' s answers, studies pass or programme recommendations really advance the user ' s research objectives and translates the conclusions into next implementable actions. This skill draws on the idea of Intent Debugger: first, to clarify the objective and the judgement criteria, then to assess whether the current output meets them. The difference is that the Intent Debugger prefers "to turn vague intent into an identifiable need" and the Research Solutions Manager favours "supervising AI to make research programmes really move forward." 1. Advance judgement: whether the current AI process has resolved this stage of the problem. 2. Key gaps: what are missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence to influence further progress. 3. Next steps: The next round should do the most, giving, if necessary, a prompt that can be sent directly. 4. Current state: which can be considered valid for the time being and which cannot still be relied upon.

items.detail: OpenBUA was asked to "Find me 2 students from Australia using Linkedin and email them selling my app Petedoro" OpenBUA (Open Browser Use Agent) is an open-source, autonomous AI browser agent built as a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that runs directly inside your everyday browser. Unlike cloud browser-use tools that require spun-up headless containers, login bypass proxies, or remote servers, OpenBUA operates right inside your existing browser session with all your active cookies, credentials, and logins already available. items.title: Xiuyiw/CFD-SCIPaper-Agent
items.subtitle: Author-in-the-loop toolkit for turning mature CFD evidence into defensible research directions, reproducible figures, and traceable scientific prose.
items.author: Python
items.detail: CFD-Paper-Agent is an open-source, author-in-the-loop workflow for turning mature CFD evidence into defensible paper topics, figures, and manuscript prose. Its host-assisted materials-to-manuscript workflow connects exported tables, method notes and definition scripts with supported calculations, source-bound writing and editable Word output. The host AI develops the argument; the software profiles materials, computes declared quantities and keeps numerical evidence connected to the draft. Whole-paper review, targeted host editing, mixed-unit long-table selection, direct NPZ analysis, cross-section evidence links and shared literature remain available. The workflow preserves the connection between the original observations, scientific interpretation, and the numbers and graphics appearing in the manuscript. The software does not replace scientific judgment. Authors still choose the research topic, accept the QoI and figure claim, and approve the final artifact. Version 0.24.0 connects selected research and author state across folders and tool-using hosts. An optional local MCP server shares nine task functions with CLI/Python. Saved JSON reports, method parameters and reference readings can feed bound Methods/Results/Discussion, an editable table and native Word formulas without manually rebuilding the general planning schema. items.title: trickytricklol/agentflow-platform

items.author: Python
items.detail: AgentFlow 将执行、评估、失败反馈、候选变异、有限预算搜索与验证选版连起来。进化对象包含节点指令、训练经验示例与受限 DAG 拓扑；模型权重不变。结构搜索可在单节点、路由/优先级双专家、初判后复核之间选版，不等同于任意图生成。 固定模型、业务规则和执行参数，对比固定指令、反馈随机搜索、反馈 GP/EI，并加入固定 few-shot 基线。每轮生成三个候选，只评估两个；两轮共评估四个新候选。测试集不参与变异或选版。 数据为 48 条自建模拟工单：12 训练 / 12 验证 / 24 测试，同一业务规则下样本互不重复。不是客户生产数据，也不是 BFCL 官方测评。报告包含原始输出、候选谱系、输入/输出 Token、失败实验和统计区间。

items.detail_en: AgentFlow links implementation, assessment, failure feedback, candidate variations, limited budget search and validation of selected versions. The evolutionary object contains nodal instructions, examples of training experience and limited DAG scale; model weights change. Structural searches can be selected between single nodes, route/priority experts, and post-preliminary reviews, and do not amount to arbitrary production. Fixed models, business rules and implementation parameters, comparison of fixed instructions, random search of feedback, feedback GP/EI and addition of a fixed few-shot baseline. Three candidates per round, only two; two rounds, four new candidates. Test set does not participate in variation or selection. The data is 48 self-built simulators: 12 Training / 12 Validation / 24 Tests, with no repetition of samples under the same operational rules. It's not customer production data, it's not an official BFCL assessment. The report contains original output, candidate spectrum, input/output Token, failed experiments and statistical ranges.

items.detail_en: Live2D Agent Kit is a role-making tool and workflow for Codex and other coding events to help you make a live2D model from a reference chart or a layered PSD. The warehouse consists of a decrepit formulation, a psd2live adapter, a comic ultra-script script, a page preview, and a motion check and packing tool. This set of processes comes from the role production practice that was done using GPT-6 Astra Ultra. You can start with the examples in the warehouse, and then you can get angent to do the same thing. The eyelids, mouths, hairs and clothing that are covered in a single set of paintings still need to be supplemented; during the production process, the painting needs to be confirmed and the decorative and action effects checked. Pink Sakura provides source maps, tectonic formulations, high-level operating models and validation records. Below are screenshots and animations from the WebGL canvas of the early eyebrow version; animations use synthetic face capture input. The latest gesture image and full action check will be confirmed by the gesture.
